pricing.details: Starter free — 5 lifetime sessions (any practice session over 30 seconds counts as a roleplay). Pro 7 €/month billed annually — up to 10 roleplays per week, live AI roleplays, feedback on uploaded recordings, community access. Advanced 18 €/month billed annually — unlimited roleplays, data excluded from AI training, reimbursement letter for professional development. A Monthly / Annual toggle with “Save 40%” is on the page; Business (per seat, billed annually) and Enterprise are demo / talk-to-sales and have no public seat price.
pricing.label: Freemium
